# fct_via_sessions

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_via_sessions` · dbt area: `portal`

Fact table for Via sessions. A session is a subset of a conversation's messages, with a new session triggered by a 30+ minute gap in activity. Sessions never span more than one conversation, and a session must include at least one agent action (tool-return) to exclude conversations where the advisor gave no actionable direction and the agent never acted. Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `session_id` | Primary Key. Surrogate key hashed from conversation_id and the session sequence. >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `advisor_id` | The advisor ID associated with the session. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `advisor_uuid` | The advisor UUID associated with the session. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `agent_action_count` | Count of 'tool-return' messages, agent actions taken (e.g. supplier_search, create_client) in the session. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `conversation_id` | Foreign Key. The Via conversation this session belongs to. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `conversation_session_sequence` | The ordering of this session among this conversation's sessions, starting at 1. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `days_since_previous_session` | Days between the end of the advisor's previous session and the start of this one. Null for the advisor's first session. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `distinct_tool_name_count` | Count of distinct tools invoked during the session. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `has_created_entity` | True if the Via assistant created any entity (e.g. client, intake form, trip) during the session. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `has_supplier_return` | True if any message in the session returned a supplier. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `hours_since_previous_session` | Hours between the end of the advisor's previous session and the start of this one. Null for the advisor's first session. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_first_session_of_conversation` | True when this is the conversation's first qualifying session (conversation_session_sequence = 1). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `message_count` | Total number of messages in the session across all message kinds. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `mins_since_previous_session` | Minutes between the end of the advisor's previous session and the start of this one. Null for the advisor's first session. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `session_at` | Timestamp of the session's first message. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `session_ended_at` | Timestamp of the session's last message. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `session_length_mins` | Minutes between the session's first and last message, across all message kinds. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `session_sequence` | The ordering of this session among all of the advisor's other sessions, across all of their conversations, starting at 1. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `text_count` | Count of 'text' messages (text responses from the agent) in the session. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `tool_call_count` | Count of 'tool-call' messages, the agent invoking a tool (e.g. supplier_search, create_client) in the session. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `tool_call_to_text_ratio` | tool_call_count divided by text_count. Null when the session has no text messages. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `total_cost_usd` | Total cost of the session in USD, summed across all messages. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `user_prompt_count` | Count of 'user-prompt' messages (messages sent by the advisor) in the session. >> SOURCE - Portal |
